calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name

SELECT DISTINCT
  p.sku,
  p.product_name
FROM dim_product p
WHERE LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%oulu kaakkuri%'
  OR LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE '%kaakkuri%'
  OR p.sku = 101624
ORDER BY p.sku

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT sku) as product_count,
  COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name LIKE '%oulu%'
  OR brand LIKE '%oulu%'
  OR product_name LIKE '%kaakkuri%'
  OR brand LIKE '%kaakkuri%'
